definitions: An emotional connection where one person invests significantly more than the other, often without the other person's full awareness or reciprocation.
A relationship dynamic characterized by an imbalance of emotional effort and attachment, typically originating from one individual's perspective.
examples: She developed a one-sided psychological bond with the celebrity.
The therapist identified a one-sided psychological bond in the patient's past.
It was clearly a one-sided psychological bond, causing him much distress.
